records.description: ShapeShift acquired the KeepKey hardware-wallet business in 2017 and integrated the hardware wallet with the ShapeShift platform.
records.notes: Reviewed first-party ShapeShift material consistently establishes the acquisition year as 2017 but does not provide a defensible exact acquisition day in this review, so WLR keeps year precision.
records.title: ShapeShift acquired KeepKey

records.description: ShapeShift DAO material states that from January 1, 2022 KeepKey was independently owned and operated by its new owners after ShapeShift's decentralization and spinout of the hardware-wallet business.
records.notes: The current event taxonomy has no dedicated divestiture/spinout value, so this ownership change is conservatively recorded as other rather than misclassified as a rebrand, merger, or product launch.
records.title: KeepKey returned to independent ownership

records.notes: Current product page identifies the hardware wallet as current, links purchase/setup paths and states free firmware updates for life.
records.title: KeepKey — The wallet you can verify

records.notes: First-party ShapeShift retrospective states that ShapeShift announced its acquisition of KeepKey in 2017 and later spun KeepKey back into its own entity during decentralization.
records.title: ShapeShift's KeepKey Support Grows

records.notes: Official ShapeShift DAO governance material states that as of 2022-01-01 KeepKey was owned by its new owners and independently owned and operated. The post date is later than the effective ownership date and is not reused as the event date.
records.title: [SCP-71] Proposal to Create the KeepKey Workstream
